question: What is AkatuskiSites?
answer: AkatuskiSites is a pay-to-rank leaderboard for websites. One site holds the top spot, "Elite Site #1", and a Top 10 board shows the highest-ranked sites. Anyone can take #1 by paying more than the current #1 paid.

question: What does Claim #1 mean?
answer: Claim #1 means paying a bit more than whoever is #1 right now to take the top spot. The moment your payment is confirmed, your business becomes #1 and is shown on the main page with your name, logo, link and description.

question: How do I claim #1?
alternatePhrases: how to claim the top spot
how can I get the first position
answer: Claim #1 means paying a bit more than the current #1 to take the top spot. Steps: 1) Click "Claim #1". 2) Fill in your business name, website URL, optional logo and a short description, then click "Continue to payment". 3) Check the amount and click "Pay". 4) Complete the payment on the secure checkout. You become #1 as soon as it is confirmed. No account is needed.

question: How much does it cost to claim #1?
alternatePhrases: how much to become number one
what is the price to become number 1
answer: The price to claim #1 is whatever the current #1 paid plus ₹1,000. If the board is empty, the first claim is ₹1,000. The exact amount right now is shown on the "Claim #1" button and on the payment screen.

question: Why does the price keep going up?
alternatePhrases: why is it more expensive now
answer: The #1 spot always goes to whoever pays more than the current holder. So each new claim costs ₹1,000 more than the current #1 paid. The price stays the same until someone claims.

question: What is the price for the very first claim?
answer: If nobody holds #1 yet, the first claim costs ₹1,000, the minimum entry amount. After that, every claim costs ₹1,000 more than the current #1 paid.

question: Who is #1 right now?
answer: That changes whenever someone claims the spot, so I can't see it live. You can see the current #1, their amount and the price to beat on the main page of the site.

question: What details do I need to claim #1?
alternatePhrases: what do I need to fill in
what do I enter in the form
answer: The form asks for: your website or business name (up to 40 characters), your website URL (for example meerasbakery.in), an optional logo image, and a short description (up to 140 characters).

question: Is the logo required?
answer: No, the logo is optional. You can upload an image (png, jpg, webp, gif or svg) up to about 500 KB. If you skip it, the first letter of your business name is shown instead.

question: How long can the description be?
answer: The description can be up to 140 characters and is required. The business name can be up to 40 characters in the form. Keep the description to one or two lines about what you do.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: You can pay with UPI, card or netbanking through Razorpay, and by card through Stripe's payment form on the page. Pay Later and EMI are not offered. Payments are in Indian rupees (INR).

question: Is the payment safe?
alternatePhrases: do you store my card details
answer: Yes. You pay on the secure checkout of Razorpay or Stripe. AkatuskiSites never sees or stores your card, UPI or banking details. The price is decided by the server, so it cannot be changed from your browser.

question: Is it a one-time payment or a subscription?
answer: It is a one-time payment. There is no subscription and no recurring charge.

question: When do I become #1?
alternatePhrases: how fast do I get the top spot
how soon will I be number 1
answer: Immediately. You become #1 the second your payment is confirmed. If the page says "Payment received, finishing up", it will update shortly and you can safely leave the page.

question: How long will I stay #1?
alternatePhrases: how long does the top spot last
answer: There is no time limit. You stay #1 until someone pays more than your amount.

question: What happens if someone pays more than me?
alternatePhrases: kisi ne zyada paise de diye
answer: They become #1 and everyone else, including you, moves down one place on the Top 10 board. You can take the spot back anytime by paying more than their amount.

question: What happens if I fall out of the top 10?
answer: Only the top 10 are shown. If you drop below rank 10 you no longer appear on the visible board, but your record is kept in an archive and is not deleted.

question: Can I take back #1 after losing it?
answer: Yes. Anyone, including a business that just lost the spot, can take #1 again by paying more than the current #1's amount.

question: Do I need an account or to sign up?
answer: No. There is no login or signup. Anyone can claim #1 just by filling in the form and paying.

question: What happens if my payment fails?
alternatePhrases: my payment failed what to do
answer: You are not charged for a failed payment. On Razorpay the window stays open and shows the reason with a "Retry payment" option, so you can try again. If you close it, the order is cancelled and the price is released. Stripe shows "Payment not completed — you were not charged".

question: What if I close the payment window or leave the page?
alternatePhrases: left in the middle of payment
answer: Nothing is charged if you do not complete the payment. The price that was locked for you is released when you close the window. You can start again whenever you like.

question: Was I charged if the payment was cancelled?
answer: No. If you see "Payment cancelled" or "Payment not completed", you were not charged. If money was deducted but your spot did not update, please raise a support ticket from the footer with the details.

question: My money was deducted but I am not #1. What now?
alternatePhrases: payment done but rank not updated
amount deducted but no top spot
paisa kat gaya par rank nahi mila
answer: First wait a minute: "Payment received, finishing up" means it is being finalised and your spot will update shortly. If it still does not update, raise a support ticket from the footer with your name, website and payment reference, and the team will reply by email within 24 hours.

question: How long do I have to complete the payment?
alternatePhrases: how long is the price locked
answer: When you start paying, the price is locked for you for 15 minutes. If the payment is not completed in that time, the order expires and the price is released.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: A refund policy isn't published on the site, so I can't promise one. Please raise a support ticket from the footer and explain your case; the team replies by email within 24 hours.

question: Can I change my name, link, logo or description after paying?
answer: There is no edit option on the site after payment. Please raise a support ticket from the footer with the change you need and the team will get back to you by email.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Click "support" in the footer and fill in your name, email, subject and details. You get a reference code like VRT-48213, and the team replies by email within 24 hours.

question: How long does support take to reply?
answer: The team replies by email within 24 hours of your ticket.

question: What is the support reference code?
answer: It is a code like VRT-48213 shown right after you submit a support ticket. Quote it whenever you follow up about that ticket.

question: Will I get more traffic or SEO benefits?
answer: Your business name, logo, link and description are shown to everyone who visits the main page while you hold or appear on the board. I can't promise any traffic, sales or SEO results.

question: How is the ranking decided?
answer: Only by amount, highest first. If two amounts are the same, the one paid earlier ranks higher.

question: Can I buy rank 2 or rank 5 directly?
answer: No. Every claim has to be higher than the current #1, so a successful claim always becomes #1. Others then move down one place.

question: Why do I see "too many attempts"?
answer: To prevent abuse, checkout attempts and support tickets are limited per 10 minutes. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

question: What is Buy me a chai?
answer: It is an optional way to support the developer in the footer. You can scan the UPI QR code or use the UPI ID akatsukisites@ptaxis. It is voluntary and not needed to claim #1.

question: Who made AkatuskiSites?
answer: AkatuskiSites is built and maintained independently by its developer. For anything specific, you can raise a support ticket from the footer.

question: Which currency is used?
answer: All amounts are in Indian rupees (₹ INR).

question: Can I pay from outside India?
answer: Card payments are available through Stripe's payment form. Whether a particular international card is accepted depends on the card and the payment provider. If it doesn't work, please raise a support ticket from the footer.

question: Do you give an invoice or GST bill?
answer: Invoice or GST details aren't mentioned on the site, so I can't confirm. Please raise a support ticket from the footer and ask the team.

question: Can I claim for more than one website?
answer: Each claim is for one website. You can start another claim for a different website the same way, filling in its own details and paying the then-current price.

question: What is shown in the Top 10 list?
answer: For each of the 10 highest-ranked businesses: rank, logo (or first letter), name, website link and the amount paid. Rows get smaller as the amount gets smaller.

question: Are the website links clickable?
answer: Yes. Each website link opens in a new tab, so visitors can go straight to your site.

question: Is AkatuskiSites legit?
answer: Payments are processed by Razorpay and Stripe, and AkatuskiSites never stores your payment details. It is built and maintained independently. If you have a concern, you can raise a support ticket from the footer.
